fields.label: Company
fields.description: Links this record to the related Company.

fields.label: Contract Number
fields.description: Unique sales contract reference. Auto-generated from settings if left blank.

fields.label: Contract Date
fields.description: Date of the sales contract.

fields.label: Valid Until
fields.description: Date until which the contract terms remain valid. Defaults from settings if not provided.

fields.label: Contract Status
fields.options:
Draft
Under Review
Approved
Active
Cancelled
Closed
fields.description: Operational contract status used for workflow and reporting.

fields.label: Workflow State
fields.options:
Draft
Under Review
Approved
Active
Cancelled
Closed
fields.description: Current workflow status for this sales contract.

fields.label: Contract Type
fields.description: Classifies the sales contract by sales channel or pricing structure.

fields.label: Source Reservation
fields.description: Unit Reservation from which this sales contract was created, if any.

fields.label: Settings
fields.description: Sales Contract Settings used for validation and numbering.

fields.label: Real Estate Project
fields.description: Real estate project that contains the sold unit.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: Real estate unit being sold under this contract.

fields.label: Building
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Floor
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Unit Type
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Expected Sale Price
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Unit Status
fields.description: Current status of the unit at the time of contract creation.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Existing customer linked to this sales contract.

fields.label: Lead
fields.description: Potential customer from ERPNext CRM linked to this contract.

fields.label: Buyer Name
fields.description: Visible buyer name when Customer or Lead is not yet available.

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Classifies the buying party by ERPNext party type.

fields.label: Mobile No
fields.description: Buyer mobile number for contact and payment notifications.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: Buyer email address for contract communications.

fields.label: ID Number
fields.description: Buyer identification number such as national ID or passport.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Buyer address for contract and legal purposes.

fields.label: Sale Price
fields.description: Total sale price for the unit before discounts.

fields.label: Discount Percent
fields.description: Discount percentage applied to the sale price.

fields.label: Discount Amount
fields.description: Absolute discount amount subtracted from the sale price.

fields.label: Net Price
fields.description: Calculated as sale price minus discount amount. This is the amount used for installment calculations.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Transaction currency. Defaults from company currency when available.

fields.label: Payment Terms Type
fields.description: Payment structure for this sales contract.

fields.label: Down Payment Percent
fields.description: First payment as a percentage of net price, used for default installment generation.

fields.label: Down Payment Amount
fields.description: Calculated as net price multiplied by down payment percent.

fields.label: Contract Terms
fields.description: Contractual terms and conditions for this sales agreement.

fields.label: Installments
fields.description: Child table storing the installment payment schedule for this sales contract.

fields.label: Total Installment Amount
fields.description: Sum of all installment amounts. Must equal net price within tolerance.

fields.label: Outstanding Installment Amount
fields.description: Total installment amount minus any rows already marked Paid or Waived.

fields.label: Installment Count
fields.description: Total number of installment rows in this schedule.

fields.label: Sales Order
fields.description: Sales Order linked to this contract. Created in a later phase.

fields.label: First Invoice
fields.description: First Sales Invoice generated from the installment schedule. Created in a later phase.

fields.label: Invoices Created
fields.description: Flag indicating whether Sales Invoices have been generated from this contract.

fields.label: Converted Date
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Converted By
fields.description: Calculated value updated automatically from linked records.

fields.label: Cancellation Reason
fields.description: Reason for contract cancellation. Required before cancellation.

fields.label: Cancellation Date
fields.description: Date and time when the contract was cancelled.

fields.label: Previous Unit Status
fields.description: Unit status before this contract was approved.

fields.label: Previous Marketing Status
fields.description: Unit marketing status before this contract was approved.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: Additional notes or explanation for this Sales Contract.

name: Sales Contract
description: Operational real estate unit sales contract with installment schedule. Does not create Sales Invoices or Payment Entries in this phase.
